summary: Truth or Consequences Municipal Airport (TCS/KTCS) is a public-use airport serving the small city of Truth or Consequences in Sierra County, New Mexico. The city itself is notable for having been renamed in 1950 after the popular radio and television game show hosted by Ralph Edwards. The airport primarily supports general aviation and provides access to the region's renowned natural hot springs and Rio Grande Valley attractions.
faqs:
Q: How far is the airport from downtown Truth or Consequences?
A: The airport is located just a few miles northwest of the city center, typically a short 10-minute drive.

Q: Does the airport offer commercial airline service?
A: No, Truth or Consequences Municipal Airport is primarily a general aviation facility with no scheduled commercial passenger service.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: The airport features a terminal building, tie-down areas for aircraft, and basic services for private and general aviation pilots.

Q: Can I rent a car at the airport?
A: Car rental options are limited; visitors typically arrange rentals through local agencies in town or via nearby larger airports.
transport_tips: Rental cars and taxis are the most common ways to reach the city from the airport, though availability should be arranged in advance. Ride-sharing services may be limited in this rural area of New Mexico, so contacting local providers ahead of arrival is recommended. The airport's small size means walk-up ground transportation options are minimal, so planning ahead is essential.
local_tip: If you're flying in, take advantage of Truth or Consequences' famous natural hot springs—many of the local hotels offer private mineral bath facilities that have made the town a well-known wellness destination for decades.
